```{r}
install.packages("ISLR2")
```

```{r}
# Load data
library(ISLR2)

# Set random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(1)

# Randomly select 196 observations for the training set
train <- sample(392, 196)

# Fit a linear regression model
lm.fit <- lm(mpg ~ horsepower, data = Auto, subset = train)

# Calculate validation set MSE
attach(Auto)
mean((mpg - predict(lm.fit, Auto))[-train]^2)

# Fit a quadratic regression model
lm.fit2 <- lm(mpg ~ poly(horsepower, 2),
              data = Auto,
              subset = train)

# Validation MSE for quadratic model
mean((mpg - predict(lm.fit2, Auto))[-train]^2)

# Fit a cubic regression model
lm.fit3 <- lm(mpg ~ poly(horsepower, 3),
              data = Auto,
              subset = train)

# Validation MSE for cubic model
mean((mpg - predict(lm.fit3, Auto))[-train]^2)
```

```{r}
# Create a different training/validation split
set.seed(2)
train <- sample(392, 196)

# Linear model
lm.fit <- lm(mpg ~ horsepower, subset = train)
mean((mpg - predict(lm.fit, Auto))[-train]^2)

# Quadratic model
lm.fit2 <- lm(mpg ~ poly(horsepower, 2),
              data = Auto,
              subset = train)
mean((mpg - predict(lm.fit2, Auto))[-train]^2)

# Cubic model
lm.fit3 <- lm(mpg ~ poly(horsepower, 3),
              data = Auto,
              subset = train)
mean((mpg - predict(lm.fit3, Auto))[-train]^2)
```

```{r}
# Fit linear regression using glm()
glm.fit <- glm(mpg ~ horsepower, data = Auto)

# View coefficients
coef(glm.fit)

# Compare with lm()
lm.fit <- lm(mpg ~ horsepower, data = Auto)
coef(lm.fit)

# Load boot package
library(boot)

# Perform LOOCV
glm.fit <- glm(mpg ~ horsepower, data = Auto)

cv.err <- cv.glm(Auto, glm.fit)

# Display CV estimate
cv.err$delta
```
```{r}
set.seed(17)
# Create vector to store CV errors
cv.error <- rep(0, 10)

# Fit polynomials of degree 1 to 10
for (i in 1:10) {

  glm.fit <- glm(mpg ~ poly(horsepower, i),
                 data = Auto)

  cv.error[i] <- cv.glm(Auto, glm.fit)$delta[1]
}

# Display LOOCV errors
cv.error
```
```{r}
# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(17)

# Store CV errors
cv.error.10 <- rep(0, 10)

# Perform 10-fold CV for polynomial models
for (i in 1:10) {

  glm.fit <- glm(mpg ~ poly(horsepower, i),
                 data = Auto)

  cv.error.10[i] <- cv.glm(Auto,
                           glm.fit,
                           K = 10)$delta[1]
}

# Display CV errors
cv.error.10
```
```{r}
# Function to estimate alpha
alpha.fn <- function(data, index) {

  X <- data$X[index]
  Y <- data$Y[index]

  (var(Y) - cov(X, Y)) /
    (var(X) + var(Y) - 2 * cov(X, Y))
}

# Estimate alpha using all observations
alpha.fn(Portfolio, 1:100)

# Bootstrap sample
set.seed(7)

alpha.fn(
  Portfolio,
  sample(100, 100, replace = TRUE)
)
```
```{r}
# Generate 1000 bootstrap samples
boot(Portfolio,
     alpha.fn,
     R = 1000)
# Function returning intercept and slope
boot.fn <- function(data, index)
  coef(
    lm(mpg ~ horsepower,
       data = data,
       subset = index)
  )

# Apply to full dataset
boot.fn(Auto, 1:392)
```


```{r}
set.seed(1)

boot.fn(
  Auto,
  sample(392, 392, replace = TRUE)
)

boot.fn(
  Auto,
  sample(392, 392, replace = TRUE)
)
# Estimate coefficient variability using 1000 bootstrap samples
boot(Auto,
     boot.fn,
     1000)
# Standard errors from ordinary least squares
summary(
  lm(mpg ~ horsepower,
     data = Auto)
)$coef
# Function returning coefficients from quadratic model
boot.fn <- function(data, index)
  coef(
    lm(mpg ~ horsepower + I(horsepower^2),
       data = data,
       subset = index)
  )

# Bootstrap coefficient estimates
set.seed(1)

boot(Auto,
     boot.fn,
     1000)
summary(
  lm(mpg ~ horsepower + I(horsepower^2),
     data = Auto)
)$coef
```
